q: Кто покупатель и продавец по сделке 100001?
sql: SELECT d.deal_no, d.seller_inn, s.name AS seller_name, d.buyer_inn, b.name AS buyer_name FROM deals d JOIN participants s ON s.inn = d.seller_inn JOIN participants b ON b.inn = d.buyer_inn WHERE d.deal_no = 100001

q: Сколько тонн хлопка-сырца продано в 2024 году?
sql: SELECT unit, SUM(volume) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE tnved = '520100' AND year = 2024 AND is_cancelled = 0 GROUP BY unit

q: Какая средняя цена портландцемента за тонну в марте 2023 года?
sql: SELECT unit, currency, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE tnved = '252329' AND year = 2023 AND month = 3 AND is_cancelled = 0 GROUP BY unit, currency

q: Топ-5 брокеров по количеству сделок в 2025 году
sql: WITH b AS (SELECT seller_broker AS code, deal_no FROM deals WHERE year = 2025 UNION SELECT buyer_broker, deal_no FROM deals WHERE year = 2025) SELECT b.code, br.name, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM b JOIN brokers br ON br.code = b.code GROUP BY b.code ORDER BY deals DESC LIMIT 5

q: Сколько сделок аннулировано в 2026 году?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM deals WHERE year = 2026 AND is_cancelled = 1

q: Какой курс доллара был 15.06.2024?
sql: SELECT date, rate FROM usd_rates WHERE date = '2024-06-15'

q: Сумма экспортных сделок в 2023 году в сумах
sql: SELECT SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_uzs, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE year = 2023 AND contract_type = 'Экспортный' AND is_cancelled = 0

q: Сколько сделок у компании Qojo Invest?
sql: SELECT p.inn, p.name, COUNT(d.deal_no) AS deals FROM participants p LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.seller_inn = p.inn OR d.buyer_inn = p.inn WHERE p.name_key LIKE '%' || ckey('Qojo Invest') || '%' GROUP BY p.inn

q: В каком регионе больше всего сделок по муке?
sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE tnved = '110100' GROUP BY region ORDER BY deals DESC LIMIT 1

q: STIR 953758401 qaysi kompaniya va qaysi viloyatda?

q: Namangan viloyatida 2025-yilda eng ko'p sotilgan tovar qaysi?
